DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS calculate_cpi(integer, integer, integer, text);
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_cpi(hist_sign integer, research_val integer, cult_score integer, conserve_status text) RETURNS numeric AS $$
DECLARE
    status_val numeric;
BEGIN
    status_val := CASE LOWER(COALESCE(conserve_status, 'fair'))
        WHEN 'excellent' THEN 1
        WHEN 'good' THEN 3
        WHEN 'fair' THEN 5
        WHEN 'poor' THEN 7
        WHEN 'critical' THEN 10
        ELSE 5
    END;
    RETURN ((hist_sign + research_val + cult_score) * (10 - status_val)) / 30.0;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
